
```{r, message= FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
```

# Data Import


BMF file from:
https://nccsdata.s3.amazonaws.com/harmonized/bmf/unified/MD_BMF_V1.1.csv 
Neighborhood csv file from (copy and paste full url): https://data.baltimorecity.gov/datasets/baltimore::neighborhood-statistical-area-nsa-boundaries/about 

```{r}
BMF <- read_csv(here::here("data","MD_BMF_V1.1.csv"))
neighborhoods <- read_csv(here::here("data", "Neighborhood_Statistical_Area_(NSA)_Boundaries.csv"))
```

## Get lat and long for shape file

Shape file from: https://data.baltimorecity.gov/datasets/baltimore::neighborhood-statistical-area-nsa-boundaries/about

```{r}
neighborhood_shape <-st_read("data/Neighborhood_Statistical_Area_(NSA)_Boundaries/Neighborhood_Statistical_Area_(NSA)_Boundaries.shp")
```


## Check for missing data

```{r}
BMF_geo <- BMF %>% dplyr::select(EIN, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE)
any(is.na(BMF_geo$LATITUDE)) # no missing location info
any(is.na(BMF_geo$LONGITUDE))
```


## Limit to just Baltimore

Based on coordinates...

```{r}
BMF_sf <- st_as_sf(BMF, coords = c('LONGITUDE', 'LATITUDE'), crs = 4326)  # Use LONGITUDE and LATITUDE columns and convert to sf object (with a geometry column), use coordinate reference system 4326
BMF_trans <- st_transform(BMF_sf, 9311) #EPSG:9311, convert lat and long to NAD27 / US National Atlas Equal Area for the org data
neighborhood_tt <- st_transform(neighborhood_shape$geometry, 9311)# convert Baltimore shape file to NAD27 / US National Atlas Equal Area coordinate reference system
```

Look for the intersection of orgs with locations within Baltimore

```{r}
# Make a new column for each org row about if the location is located within the Baltimore shape outline
intersection <- BMF_sf %>% mutate(
  intersection_row = as.integer(st_intersects(BMF_trans, neighborhood_tt )))

# filter for just data within Baltimore dropping other MD orgs (in other words dropping orgs that have an NA value for the intersection)
in_balt <- intersection %>% drop_na(intersection_row) # just Baltimore locations
```

## Combining it all together 

Want the org info, and neighborhood info, and shape information together to enable making maps later.

```{r}
neighborhood_shape <-as_tibble(neighborhood_shape) # convert to tibble to work with later
neighborhood_shape<-neighborhood_shape %>%  mutate(id = row_number()) # add row number column
org_data <-left_join(in_balt, neighborhood_shape, by = c("intersection_row" = "id")) # look for what row numbers align with the shape file

# save neighborhood R file and org data with neighborhood info
write_rds(neighborhood_shape, file = here::here("data", "processed", "neighborhood_shape_data.rds"))
write_rds(org_data, file = here::here("data", "processed", "org_data.rds"))

```
